name: Cloudflare Workers AI
description: Neurons used today against the free daily allocation of your Cloudflare account.

auth.notice: Add a Cloudflare API token with the Account Analytics: Read permission in Settings

account.label: Account ID
account.description: Open the dashboard with the link below, then copy the address from your browser's address bar (or the Account ID shown in the dashboard) and paste it here: AI Meter keeps only the 32-character ID.
account.notice: Add your Cloudflare account ID in Settings to see your Neurons

request.body: {"query":"query ($account: string!, $date: Date!) { viewer { accounts(filter: {accountTag: $account}) { aiInferenceAdaptiveGroups(limit: 1, filter: {date_geq: $date}) { count sum { totalNeurons } } } } }","variables":{"account":"{key:account}","date":"{date:utc}"}}
request.errorNotice: Cloudflare refused to show this account's Neurons: check the account ID and that the token has the Account Analytics: Read permission for it

it.Open the dashboard with the link below,: Apri la dashboard con il link qui sotto, poi copia l'indirizzo dalla barra del browser (o l'Account ID mostrato nella dashboard) e incollalo qui: AI Meter tiene solo l'ID di 32 caratteri.
it.Add your Cloudflare account ID in Settin: Aggiungi in Impostazioni l'ID del tuo account Cloudflare per vedere i Neuron
it.Cloudflare refused to show this account': Cloudflare non mostra i Neuron di questo account: verifica l'ID account e che il token abbia il permesso Account Analytics: Read per l'account
